description: Permanently delete a trading bot and its configuration -- irreversible, the bot cannot be recovered after this call. Refuses if the bot still has an open trade recorded (the delete itself doesn't close positions, so deleting it now would orphan that trade with nothing left to manage or close it) -- close_position and stop_bot it first. Confirm with the user before calling. Get bot IDs from list_bots.

id.description: The bot ID to delete, obtained from list_bots.

name: delete_bot
